name: Kami-sama Shibai
source:
Part of a multimedia project that began in the radio show "Kimura Ryohei/Okamoto Nobuhiko Dengeki Girl's Smile".

The Norse mythological god Loki has moved to the human world chasing new opportunities.  A dramatic kaleidoscopic story that creates two “god-class” plays with members of the theater club, including genius high school student actor Mahiro.
translation:
本作属于一个发端于广播节目《木村良平、冈本信彦的电击Girl’s Smile》的跨媒体企划。

北欧神话中的神祇洛基为了追寻新的机遇，来到了人类世界。他将与天才高中生演员真寻等戏剧社成员一起，创作两出“神级”戏剧，展开一段跌宕多彩的故事。
